conventions.units: Pixels in the OUTPUT frame, origin top-left. Times in seconds from item start (30 fps; 1 frame = 0.0333 s). L01 uses CANVAS coordinates (3240x1440) where stated, otherwise tile-local.
conventions.crop: Fractions of the SOURCE image {x,y,w,h} (0..1, origin top-left). The crop rect already has the output aspect ratio; scale it to fill the frame. Never stretch.
conventions.kenburns: Linear interpolation of the crop rect from `from` to `to` over the scene duration with ease 'inOutSine' unless stated.
conventions.text_box: x,y = top-left of the text box; w = max width (wrap inside); align inside the box. `anchor: bottom` means y is the BOTTOM edge of the box (box grows upwards).
conventions.stack: Elements in a `stack` are laid out top-to-bottom (or bottom-up when anchor=bottom) with `gap` px between boxes.
conventions.autofit: If text exceeds max_lines at `size`, reduce size in 2 px steps down to `min_size`. If it still does not fit, STOP and report — do not shorten copy.
conventions.strings: Every `text` value is final copy (verbatim from 03-copy.json or content/i18n.ts). Do not retype — copy-paste. Armenian punctuation ։ ՝ « » ՞ must be preserved.
conventions.rendering: Recommended: render text/graphic layers with HTML+CSS in headless Chromium (exact font stacks below, font-feature-settings normal, -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased) to transparent PNG, then composite with ffmpeg. Do not use editor auto-captions or system fonts.
conventions.placeholders: Text containing [..._ճշտել] must NOT be published. Producer renders a draft with the placeholder visible in red #ff4d4d for review; the final render requires the resolved value from the caller.
conventions.overlay_linear_stops: type 'linear_stops': vertical gradient of `color`; `stops` = [[y_px, alpha], ...] sorted by y, alpha interpolated linearly between stops, constant before the first and after the last stop.
conventions.letter_spacing_centering: Centred text with letter-spacing: add padding-left equal to the letter-spacing (CSS adds tracking after the last glyph) so the visible glyphs are optically centred.
conventions.default_texts: This spec uses the DEFAULT (undated) copy everywhere: no '15.11 · 20:00' on L02, L03 s6 = «Շուտով՝ մեր կայքը». Dated variants in 03-copy.md are NOT rendered.
conventions.verbatim: All `text` values are copied programmatically from 03-copy.json (slides[].title/body, scenes[].text) except: eyebrow URLs on L04 (factual page addresses) and site-native strings captured from the site itself. Round 1 exception: L03 s1 title uses an explicit line break instead of the middle « · » (see items.L03.slides[0]); the words are verbatim.
conventions.line_breaks:
A text value containing '\n' is an EXPLICIT line break: render with CSS white-space: pre-line (or split into
). Do not let the browser re-wrap such a line; if a single explicit line does not fit `w` at `size`, autofit the whole box (2 px steps to min_size), else STOP.
conventions.logo_files: Logos are SVG (vector). Render via (or inline SVG) in headless Chromium at the given w/h — any size is sharp, no 1:1 limit. Fallback only if a renderer cannot read SVG: the PNG of the same name (now 1700x1240, 4x of the 425x310 viewBox) downscaled with Lanczos. Never mix old (pre-2026-11-10 11:03) logo renders with new ones in one item.
conventions.mask: `mask: {type:'linear', y0, y1}` on a group = CSS mask-image linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 at y0, transparent at y1) in SLIDE pixels; the group is fully invisible below y1.

L02.version: v4 (2026-11-11, owner sent REAL project photos: three start→progress→result stories + a finished wooden house). Base: v3b (light theme, logo build without hook texts, end card without CTA/handle).
L02.supersedes: v3/v3b (stock mood stills), v2 (dark + 4 GARON photos), v1 (splash capture). Earlier frames/covers must NOT be reused or mixed. The stock files stay untouched in marketing/instagram/assets/stock/ but are NOT used by L02 any more.
L02.concept: LIGHT version. Acts A–C unchanged from v3b: the GARON mark is BUILT on a dark-grey blueprint grid on paper, glint, wordmark tracks in — no text. Act D (6.0–22.5 s): the gold piece of the finished logo grows into a 3:4 architectural window and opens the first of three REAL GARON project stories — Pool A, Pool B, House — each start → progress → result. Inside a story the stages change with a gold vertical wipe (start→progress) and the roof-band mask (progress→result); every new story opens with the gold piece. A small section label («Լողավազան» / «Տուն») and a stage label («Սկիզբ» / «Ընթացք» / «Արդյունք», dark gold) with a 3-segment progress bar sit top-right next to the corner logo, inside the safe zone. Then a finished wooden house («Փայտե տուն» · «Արդյունք») as a two-plate gallery on the drawing sheet (horizontal photos stay horizontal). Act E: v3b end card on paper — logo, «Շուտով», services line, garon.am (no CTA, no handle).

render.engine: ONE html page in headless Chromium (Playwright), viewport 1080x1920, deviceScaleFactor 1, background #f5f5f3 (theme.bg). Fonts: same @fontsource files as ig_lib.js (Cormorant Garamond 300/400/500, Noto Serif Armenian 300/400/500, Montserrat 400/500/600, Noto Sans Armenian 400/500/600). await document.fonts.ready and every .decode() before frame 0.
render.frame_loop: for f = 0..779: page.evaluate(setFrame, f) (a pure function of f, no CSS animations/transitions, no timers, no Date/random) → page.screenshot({clip:{x:0,y:0,width:1080,height:1920}}) → frames/L02_%03d.png. Render order of frames is irrelevant (deterministic).
render.keyframes: Every animated property is a list of keys [frame, value, easing]. Before the first key: first value; after the last key: last value. Between key k and k+1: v = v_k + (v_k+1 − v_k) · E((f − f_k)/(f_k+1 − f_k)), E = easing NAMED IN KEY k (see `easings`). "hold" = keep v_k until f_k+1 then jump. Vector values ([x,y] or {x,y,w,h}) interpolate component-wise.

easings.note: CSS cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2) control points; evaluate exactly like CSS (solve x(t)=p by Newton/bisection, return y(t)).

render.encode: ffmpeg -framerate 30 -i frames/L02_%03d.png -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 18 -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -c:a aac -b:a 320k -shortest -movflags +faststart L02_reel.mp4  (silent AAC track; music is added in the Instagram app, see `audio`). Check: ffprobe → 1080x1920, 30 fps, 780 frames, 26.000 s.
render.reference_prototype: marketing/instagram/2026-11-11-launch/04-L02v2-reference.js — art-director prototype (file name kept from v2; it now renders v4 and reads everything from items.L02). Run: NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node 04-L02v2-reference.js <repo> <out> all  (≈ 3 min for 780 frames). If code and spec disagree, the spec wins.
render.fonts_check: Armenian glyphs must come from Noto Serif Armenian / Noto Sans Armenian (check document.fonts / computed font in a test frame). STOP if a fallback system font is used.

timebase.note: Bar n starts at frame 60·(n−1). Every cut/transition start is on a beat (multiple of 15). The reel is exactly 13 bars; the loop restarts on a downbeat (f780 = bar 14.1).

photo_rules.sources: ONLY GARON's own project photos listed in `shots` / `sheets` (owner-confirmed as GARON work): pool-A, pool-B, house-A from the enhanced/ folders (owner-approved processing, tools/enhance_photos.py) and house-B-wood ORIGINAL files (owner: keep as is). NO stock (assets/stock is not used any more), NO public/stock, NO AI generation.
photo_rules.grade: CSS filter on each : saturate(0.92) contrast(1.05) (= brand.photo_grade) on top of the enhanced files. No other look.
photo_rules.resolution: Scale is judged against the ORIGINAL phone pixels: never more than ×1.35. Low-res originals: pool-A/03 (800x1280) slow push max ×1.277; pool-B/01 (1280x724) framed plate ×0.64–0.667; house-A/02 (960x1280) max ×1.224; house-B-wood (1290x~756) plates ×0.775–0.78.
photo_rules.crop_impl: crop {x,y,w,h} (fractions of the SOURCE) → target box (BW,BH): scale = BW/(w·SW); width SW·scale, height SH·scale, left = box.x − x·SW·scale, top = box.y − y·SH·scale, inside an overflow:hidden container = the box. Crop rects already have the box aspect; never stretch. image-rendering auto (Chromium high-quality resample).
photo_rules.push: crop interpolates crop_from → crop_to linearly over the shot life (constant slow push/pan).
photo_rules.clip_impl: Reveal masks = CSS clip-path: polygon(…) in SCREEN px on a full-frame layer (left 0 top 0 1080x1920) that contains the photo box; computed per frame from the formulas below.
photo_rules.privacy: No people, no animals, no plates/addresses in frame: the crops exclude the dog (pool-B/02, house-A/03) and the person (pool-B/03). house-A/02: a tiny silhouette may remain behind the upper window glass (unidentifiable at 1080 px). No captions with places/dates/counts.

audio.source: Pick a track in the Instagram app (Meta Sound Collection / licensed library for business accounts) by MOOD + ~120 BPM, not by name. In the app, slide the track start so its first strong downbeat lands at 6.0 s (first story) and check that 3.5 s and 22.5 s fall on beats. Export the MP4 with a silent AAC track. If the music is mixed offline instead: licensed track only, -14 LUFS, -1 dBTP, fade out 25.5–26.0 s.
audio.fallback: No music: subtle SFX only (build SFX as v3b; soft hit on every transition beat listed above, low thud at 255/390/525).

L02.alt_hy: Կարճ տեսանյութ բաց ֆոնի վրա. մոխրագույն ճարտարապետական ցանցի վրա կառուցվում է GARON նշանը՝ գիծ, սյուներ, տանիքի շերտեր, ոսկեգույն մաս, հետո հայտնվում են GARON և CONSTRUCTION բառերը։ Նշանի ոսկեգույն մասը մեծանում է և բացում GARON-ի նախագծերի լուսանկարները՝ փուլ առ փուլ, «Սկիզբ», «Ընթացք», «Արդյունք» պիտակներով։ Լողավազան. ամրանավորված փոս, հետո բետոնե ավազան, հետո պատրաստի կապույտ լողավազան քարե պատի և նարդոսի մոտ։ Մեկ այլ լողավազան. կլոր կաղապարամած, հետո բետոնե ավազան ջակուզիով, հետո կապույտ խճանկարով երեսպատված լողավազան։ Տուն. հիմքի կաղապարամած, հետո բետոնե կմախք ապակիներով, հետո պատրաստի տունը գիշերը՝ լուսավոր գծերով։ Հետո՝ պատրաստի փայտե տուն լեռներում. A-աձև ճակատ, տեռաս լեռների տեսարանով, այգու կողմի ճակատ։ Վերջում՝ լոգոն, «Շուտով», «Լողավազաններ · Տներ · Վերանորոգում» և garon.am։
